target.statement: DreamPortrait (ours) achieves FID 28.47, MSC 20.72, R-P 66.31 on CelebAText-HQ (3D Forward row of Table 1)

compute.basis: Training requires 8 Tesla V100 GPUs for ~56 hours (500K + 1000K images, batch 32) plus EG3D pretrained weights and diffusion model; no code release, so full reimplementation of D-SDS, adapters, and training pipeline is needed.

blockers: CelebAText-HQ dataset access unclear (manual annotations, likely restricted)
Needs pretrained EG3D weights and Stable Diffusion 2.0-base
Full training pipeline must be reimplemented from scratch
title: Efficient Text-Guided 3D-Aware Portrait Generation with Score Distillation Sampling on Distribution
